item.title: Motorist shot, killed in West Town
item.description: <p>A man died after being shot while driving in West Town on Tuesday afternoon, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The man, 32, was driving in the 700 block of North Wolcott Avenue at 4:42 p.m. when he was shot in the chest, police said. He was taken to Stroger Hospital, where he later died.</p><p>No one is in custody.</p>

item.title: 2 in custody after 12-year-old grazed by gunfire in Austin
item.description: <p>Two persons of interest were taken into custody after a 12-year-old was grazed by a bullet in Austin on Tuesday night, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The boy was riding in the back of a vehicle in the 900 block of North Leamington at 6:50 p.m. when he was grazed in the head, police said. He was taken to Loyola University Medical Center in Maywood in fair condition.</p><p>Two people of interest were taken into custody by responding officers, police said.</p>

item.title: Doberman pinscher named Penny wins best in show at the 150th annual Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show
item.description: <p>NEW YORK — A Doberman pinscher named Penny won best in show Tuesday night at the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show, netting U.S. show dogs’ most coveted prize.</p><p>Penny bested six other finalists at New York’s Madison Square Garden.</p><p>Each dog is judged according to how closely it matches the ideal for its breed.</p><p>The winner gets a trophy, ribbons, bragging rights and the distinction of winning the milestone <a class="Link" href="https://apnews.com/article/westminster-dog-show-150t

item.title: Man charged in November Little Village stabbing
item.description: <p>A man suspected of stabbing a man in Little Village in November has been charged with attempted murder, according to Chicago police.</p><p>Octavio Garcia, 48, faces charges of attempted first-degree murder, aggravated battery with a deadly weapon and aggravated battery causing great bodily harm, police said.</p><p>Garcia is accused of stabbing and “seriously injuring” a man in the 2800 block of South Kedvale Avenue on Nov. 27, 2025, police said.</p><p>Garcia is due in court Wednesday.</p>
